description: Author custom Power BI visuals on your live Desktop model: preview, self-review, commit to PBIP.

tool_signatures.name: commit_visual
tool_signatures.description: Add one Vilsem Renderer visual to one existing PBIR page using @vilsem/core. Existing visual names are refused; the only additional changes are missing renderer resources and registration. Native visuals, slicers, bookmarks, filters, themes and model objects are not edited. After committing, relay the returned nextStep to the user verbatim.

tool_signatures.name: compare_preview
tool_signatures.description: Render with real model data at the reference aspect ratio and return reference/render side by side, critique and a structural diff. The calling agent may supply reference_structure; semantic reference properties otherwise remain unknown. Writes no report.

tool_signatures.name: connect_model
tool_signatures.description: Connect read-only to an existing model. Prefer source.kind=

tool_signatures.name: delete_template
tool_signatures.description: Delete one named user-library template only. Shipped templates, reports and models are never deleted.

tool_signatures.name: diff_visual
tool_signatures.description: Read-only comparison against one saved vilsem visual: JSON Patch diff and before/after live PNGs with critique. This writes no files. Run before replacing an existing design.

tool_signatures.name: explain_visual
tool_signatures.description: Explain a Vilsem custom visual spec, its field bindings, resolved empty-data ECharts option and exact DAX query before preview or commit. Does not inspect or modify native visuals or model objects.

tool_signatures.name: extract_design_tokens
tool_signatures.description: Get bounded PNG/JPEG image statistics only: palette/background/light-dark/aspect ratio and approximate text/gridline evidence. No ML/OCR or inferred fields/data. image is a local path or PNG/JPEG data URI.

tool_signatures.name: get_playbook
tool_signatures.description: Return the Vilsem playbook the agent must follow before building or editing visuals. Call with no arguments first (compact core + index), then request sections such as

tool_signatures.name: get_schema
tool_signatures.description: Read model context without writes. Default detail=summary omits measure DAX and relationship graph; ask for full to understand calculations and join paths. Columns include exact DAX cardinality, BLANK share and numeric/date min/max, plus up to10 distinct samples and hidden/key flags. On large models, call with profile:false first (names, types, measures and formats in seconds, no queries), then profile only the tables you need with tables:[

tool_signatures.name: list_pages
tool_signatures.description: Read existing PBIR pages and visual names, types and positions so you can choose a page and avoid overlap. This tool does not edit or validate native visuals, slicers, bookmarks, filters or report themes.

tool_signatures.name: list_templates
tool_signatures.description: List shipped and saved user templates. By default returns a compact list (id, name, description, slots, source). Pass id for one complete template (slots, params, template, exampleSpec), search to filter by text, or full:true for every template in full (very large, about 550 KB). VILSEM_TEMPLATES_DIR may point to a shared library. Unreadable user files are reported explicitly.

tool_signatures.name: list_visuals
tool_signatures.description: Read every vilsem Renderer visual across report pages from PBIR, with summary, bindings, version, layout and optional live thumbnail. Native visuals are skipped. Defaults to live thumbnails; pass thumbnails:false for metadata-only discovery. No separate manifest is used.

tool_signatures.name: preview_variants
tool_signatures.description: Compare1..4 candidate specs using ONE identical bound-data query; returns one labelled2x2 PNG and per-candidate critique. Bindings and visual-scoped measures must be shared, so design differences cannot silently change the numbers. Use this to choose between approaches before committing.

tool_signatures.name: preview_visual
tool_signatures.description: motion:auto captures actual animation in an installed fresh network-blocked headless browser when available; motion:states uses discrete timeline states, and motion:browser requires a browser. Optional frames (2..12) also returns a timeline-state contact sheet. Validate a Vilsem spec, query actual bound fields and return PNG plus option and actionable critique (default true). Critique uses rendered text bounds and option checks; inspect its limitations and iterate before committing. Theme defaults to the report theme when reportDir is supplied, light otherwise. Explicit spec.canvasTheme overrides unless a stored pane override requests report theme. maxRows is 1..10000 (default 200); bounded queries do not prove population coverage. This does not write a report.

tool_signatures.name: read_visual
tool_signatures.description: Read a saved vilsem visual: migrated full spec, original-version provenance, field bindings, layout, scoped measures, separate format-pane overrides and current live PNG. Uses connectionId or connects through definition.pbir. Never reads native visuals.

tool_signatures.name: run_dax
tool_signatures.description: Execute a read-only DAX EVALUATE table query against a connected model. Returns at most maxRows rows, default 200. Use it to inspect data and verify visual bindings; this tool does not expose XMLA commands or persistent model changes.

tool_signatures.name: save_template
tool_signatures.description: Save a validated complete spec to the OS user template library, or VILSEM_TEMPLATES_DIR. Names are lowercase slugs; existing entries are refused. This does not write a report or model.

tool_signatures.name: update_visual
tool_signatures.description: Apply RFC6902 JSON Patch to the stored vilsem spec. Validates and previews before writing; returns diff and before/after PNGs. Defaults dryRun:true. Preserves manual format-pane objects unless resetFormatting:true; renderer identity/prototype/version paths are refused. Optional etag protects a reviewed dry run from intervening saves. Native/model/report objects are never edited.

tool_signatures.name: validate_spec
tool_signatures.description: Resolve a Vilsem spec without data. With spec.measures, connectionId is required: validates schema references, cycles and scalar DAX using the connected engine. Run before preview_visual.

tool_signatures.name: validate_visuals
tool_signatures.description: Validate only Vilsem Renderer specs, reader versions and known container structure. Other official2.x declarations must fit the complete bundled2.7 contract and return an explicit compatibility warning; full validation of their declared schema is not claimed. Unknown fields are refused. Native/report-level objects are neither validated nor reported. Includes per-visual nativeMeasures and a separate summary of promotion counts.
